reply.text: "Lowkey addicted" to chest day is a good problem to have. That burn is just the long time-under-tension on a stretched pec — flys keep constant tension through the whole range, unlike pressing where the top's basically a rest point. Just don't chase the burn into sloppy reps with your shoulders rolling forward — keep a slight elbow bend and control the stretch back. If chest is your thing right now, we can build in more of it.
